data.exact_reserve_text: The Syndicate has net liabilities at 31 December 2022 of GBP 34.0m (2021: GBP 23.9m liability). Majority of this increase is attributed to the in year result which was largely driven by investment loss, offset partially by the recovery of the 2019 Year of Account ("YOA") loss from capital providers during the distribution process. The Syndicate recorded an underwriting profit before investment income of GBP 3.2m (2021: GBP 6.6m loss), mainly driven by an improvement in underwriting performance on the 2021 YOA which contributed GBP 14.0m to the underwriting result. During 2022 we saw an increase of claims incurred due to the impact of the war in Ukraine across all underwriting years. This is current held primarily in IBNR.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Recovery of a 2019 year-of-account loss from capital providers during the distribution process leading to a favourable impact on reserves for that closed year.

named_events.loss_description: Other losses for which the Syndicate had large exposure during the year were Hurricane Ian.
During 2022 we saw an increase of claims incurred due to the impact of the war in Ukraine across all underwriting years. This is current held primarily in IBNR.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2022 the Syndicate's gross claims outstanding were GBP 418.211m. Using the published gross claims development triangle (gross values), there is a net adverse prior-year development of approximately GBP 30.5m (c.7.3% of opening reserves) driven predominantly by adverse development on the 2020 underwriting year, partially offset by releases/recoveries relating to earlier closed years (notably a recovery associated with the 2019 year of account). The report cites increases in IBNR related to the war in Ukraine and large loss exposure from Hurricane Ian as contributors; reinsurance recoveries from capital providers on closed years are noted as producing favourable impacts in places. The computed prior-year movement is derived from the gross claims development table and may be distorted by explicit RITC adjustments disclosed in the technical provisions.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development figure calculated from the published GROSS claims development triangle (note 14). The triangle shows an explicit RITC impact in the claims reconciliation (Gross RITC impact GBP 23,086k) which can distort diagonals; no explicit separate gross "movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding" line was found. Values in source tables are reported in GBP 000 and have been converted to millions. Because RITC is present and the report does not provide a distinct gross prior-year movement note, the PYD derived from the triangle may be affected by RITC-related distortions.
